widgets_values: This image is a digitally-rendered illustration depicting a young girl and a young boy standing on a jagged cliff in a dark, cloudy, stormy sky. The girl, with light brown hair, is wearing a white dress and white headband, while the boy, with short brown hair, is wearing a white shirt and black pants. They are holding hands and looking into the distance. Surrounding them are large, dark, shadowy hands with many eyes emerging from the clouds, creating a creepy and ominous atmosphere. The colors are mostly dark grays and blacks, with some lighter tones in the sky and hands. The style is realistic with a touch of surrealism, and the overall tone is somber and eerie. The image has a watermark in the bottom right corner that says “BILAI,” which could be the artist’s name.<|end_of_text|>
